mapper.insert: INSERT INTO perm_node(code,name,node_type,module,description,builtin,parent_code,route_path,order_num,icon) VALUES(#{code},#{name},#{type},#{module},#{desc},TRUE,#{parent},#{route},#{order},#{icon}) ON CONFLICT (code) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE perm_node SET name=#{newName} WHERE code=#{code} AND builtin=TRUE AND name=#{oldName}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO role_definitions(role, role_name) VALUES(#{role}, #{name}) ON CONFLICT (role) DO NOTHING
INSERT INTO role_permissions(role, permission) VALUES(#{role}, #{permission}) ON CONFLICT (role, permission) DO NOTHING
INSERT INTO org_unit(org_key,name,parent_key) SELECT #{key},#{name},NULL WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM org_unit)
INSERT INTO org_unit(org_key,name,parent_key) SELECT DISTINCT tenant, tenant, NULL FROM app_users ON CONFLICT (org_key) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM seed_migration WHERE version=#{version}
mapper.update: UPDATE perm_node SET retired=TRUE WHERE code=#{code}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM role_permissions WHERE role=#{role} AND permission=#{permission}
